y1: Jesus said, “Don't store up treasures for yourselves on earth. Moths and rust destroy them there, and thieves break in and steal.”
y2: “Store up treasures in heaven. For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.” Loving and sharing is treasure stored in heaven.
y5: “You can't serve both God and wealth.” We need money, but the Master of our hearts is only God.
y6: Look at the birds and flowers
y7: “Don't worry about what you will eat or what you will wear. Look at the birds in the sky. They don't plant seeds, but God feeds them.”
y8: “Look at the lilies in the field. God dresses them more beautifully than King Solomon's clothes. How much more will He care for you!”
y10: “Your heavenly Father knows what you need.”
y11: “Seek God's Kingdom and His righteousness first, and all these things will be given to you as well. Don't worry about tomorrow.”
verse: “But seek first God's Kingdom and His righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.”
prayer: My heavenly Father, thank You for caring for me just as You feed the birds and dress the flowers. I give my worries to You. Help me to seek Your Kingdom first instead of worrying. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: treasure. Something very precious and valuable. Store up treasures in heaven.
d1: master. A person who rules and gives orders. No one can serve two masters.
d2: worry. Feeling uneasy because you think something bad might happen. Don't worry about food and clothes.
d3: lily. A beautiful flower that grows in the field. God beautifully dresses the lilies in the field.
d4: Kingdom. The place where God rules as King. Seek God's Kingdom first.
